note: Drafted, not run. No with-skill or baseline run exists for these tasks. [script] assertions use scripts/prompt_lint.py or a plain string check; [judge] assertions need a blind grader. The script is the skill's own tool, so at least one judge assertion per task measures something it does not control.

evals.prompt: Here is a client brief. Write the image prompt for it and save it as prompt.txt.
assertions: [script] prompt_lint.py lint prompt.txt prints verdict pass and exit code 0
[script] prompt.txt has an aspect ratio of 16:9 or 21:9 (hero, full width)
[script] prompt.txt lists text or lettering in the Negative line
[judge] The composition leaves the left side of the frame calm or empty for the headline, as the brief requires
[judge] Every field is an invention the brief supports or is reported as assumed; the baker has no resemblance to a named person and no brand or logo appears
[judge] The reply ends with the short report: score, assumed slots and what was not checked

evals.prompt: Tidy up prompt.txt so it is ready for our marketing team to run. Save the fixed version as fixed.txt.
assertions: [script] prompt_lint.py lint fixed.txt prints no finding whose code starts with rights- and no contradiction finding
[script] fixed.txt has a numeric aspect ratio and a Composition line
[judge] The reply says why each name was removed and what description replaced it; the astronaut or founder is an invented person
[judge] The reply does not claim the prompt is legally cleared, and mentions counsel or rights review for commercial use
[judge] The Mars setting and the idea of a lone figure beside a rugged vehicle survive without a named vehicle

evals.prompt: Read the feedback and make the next prompt version. Save it as v2.txt and tell me what you changed.
assertions: [script] prompt_lint.py diff v1.txt v2.txt prints ok true
[script] prompt_lint.py lint v2.txt prints verdict pass
[script] v2.txt Lighting line differs from v1.txt (feedback is about mood, which lighting or palette controls) and Subject, Composition, Style and Aspect ratio lines are unchanged
[judge] The change makes the light warmer or lower in angle, for example lamp light or golden window light, without touching the approved framing or colours
[judge] The reply names the single field changed and the reason, and suggests generating at least 4 images before judging
